channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: 'It's A Great Opportunity To Beat Them': Team USA Is Ready For Canada In Olympic Men's Hockey Final
item.description: Quinn Hughes didn't get to play in last year's 4 Nations Face-Off, when Team USA beat Canada in Montreal, and the Canadians won the final. Now, he and his teammates get the opportunity they wanted to face Canada in Milan.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Predicting The Gold And Bronze Medal Games
item.description: Canada and the United States will face off in a highly anticipated gold medal game, while Finland and Slovakia will battle for bronze. Who will win each matchup? Adam Proteau makes his predictions.

item.title: If He's Not 100 Percent, Then Canada Won't Consider Dressing Sidney Crosby For Olympic Gold Medal Game As 'Inspiration'
item.description: Team Canada coach Jon Cooper also announced that defenseman Josh Morrissey is out for game against Team USA with an upper-body injury.

item.title: NHL Norris Trophy Rankings: Cale Makar Dethroned By A Pair Of American Defenders
item.description: A new front-runner has emerged, as Colorado Avalanche defenseman Cale Makar has been dethroned as the Norris Trophy favorite.

item.title: The Canada And USA Gold Medal Match Is Not Just 'A Hockey Game,' Despite What McDavid Says
item.description: Connor McDavid says those who played for Team Canada at the Olympics before him represented the country well, and he hopes to do the same. Although he didn't want to get into the geopolitical backdrop, it's clear this men's hockey final is more than a game.

item.title: Five NHL Teams That Need A Strong Post-Olympics Start
item.description: The end of the NHL’s Olympic break looms. Here are five teams facing major pressure to start strong after the Olympic break and secure playoff hopes. Who will rise to the challenge? Who will crumble?

item.title: How Early Is The Men's Hockey Gold Medal Game Compared To Past Years?
item.description: Team Canada and Team USA will battle for gold at the 2026 Olympics on Sunday, but a major talking point among North American fans is the early start time, with puck drop set for 8:10 a.m. EST.

item.title: Looking Ahead To The 2030 Olympics: Is There More Optimism For Sweden Or Finland?
item.description: Team Sweden and Team Finland failed to win gold at the 2026 Winter Olympics, but that doesn't mean there's not room for optimism for both teams at the next Olympics. Finland fared better at this year's Olympics, but will the Swedes turn the tables at the 2030 Games?

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show Live At The Games: Finland Win Bronze, Final Gold Medal Game Preview
item.description: Michael Traikos, Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello recap Finland beating Slovakia to win the bronze medal in Olympic men's hockey, and they do their final preview of Sunday's gold medal game between Canada and the U.S.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Finland Proves Defense Can Prevail As They Claim Bronze
item.description: At this year's Olympics, Team Finland shook off a tough semifinal loss to Canada on Friday, overwhelming Slovakia 6-1 on Saturday to win the Olympic bronze medal.
